Exact rational dual costs have floor equal to the exhibited witness cardinalities for all fifteen n. The attached standard-library checker executed without error, including all witness distances, clique distances, exact cover inequalities and exact rational sums. Proof establishes only the explicitly finite interval.

value.rationale: Two-symbol deletion correction in ternary multisets is a natural low-dimensional coding invariant: the first nontrivial two-dimensional A2 lattice packing distance with alphabet fixed and deletion radius two. The exact \(6\le n\le20\) finite profile resolves boundary effects unavailable from an \(n^2/14\) asymptotic. Thirteen of the fifteen optima improve on the seven-syndrome cyclic construction (including \(6\) versus \(4\) at n=6); each improvement comes with a complete lower witness and a rigorous finite upper certificate. The finite cutoff is motivated by explicit certificate availability, not asserted as an all-length theorem.
